description: CALL THIS for keyword/filter-based sync queries when the user already knows what they want: "tense instrumental", "BPM 90-100", "no vocals". This is the precise-query path. Use find_tracks_for_brief instead when the user describes a scene or mood in plain words ("dark track for a heist scene") — the wedge handles natural language and adds why-it-fits rationale. Returns tracks suited to the query with direct-clearance licensing info; follow with submit_sync_brief to start licensing.

explicit.description: true = explicit only, false = non-explicit only. Omit for all.

mood.description: Mood filter, matched against moods + energy words, e.g. "aggressive".

q.description: Sync query, e.g. "club scene" or "dark aggressive". Truncated at 500 characters.

name: sync_search

outputSchema.description: sync_search response: scene-matched tracks with rights info, plus a license_block for the top hit.

_session.description: Chain session: pass _session.session_token back in the next call to continue the chain.

session_token.description: Hex session token; echo it as params._session.session_token to continue.

step.description: Hop number in this chain (1 = chain start).

license_block.description: Markdown licensing summary for the top hit: ISRC, rights holders, clearance terms, contact.

try_next.description: Suggested follow-up calls, each a pre-compiled {tool, arguments, purpose} payload.

items.description: Pre-compiled next call: copy `arguments` straight into the next tools/call.

arguments.description: Ready-to-use arguments, pre-populated from the current response.

purpose.description: Why this call is the natural next step.

title: Search Sync Catalog
